purpose: Optional real existing-system metadata for Creator connection-mapping examples; not a Creator runtime dependency or a Cowork availability claim.

observation.method: MCP initialize, notifications/initialized, and tools/list over the public endpoint

extracted_tools_document.transformation: Extracted result.tools from the JSON-RPC SSE response and wrapped it as tools; all tool definitions are semantically unchanged.

documented_service_facts.content_scope: Public documentation, not training or user-profile information

contract_observations: All three actual tools include top-level title as well as annotations.title.
microsoft_docs_search has no required array; query is a string property with a null default annotation.
microsoft_code_sample_search requires query; language is an optional string with a null default annotation.
The search and code-sample tools include outputSchema with nullable type arrays. The fetch tool does not include outputSchema.
Server-provided readOnlyHint and other annotations are descriptive hints, not a security boundary or native approval.
claim_boundaries: This is a point-in-time public MCP metadata observation, not a traditional REST contract guaranteed to remain stable.
Use Cowork's own supported MCP connection facilities at runtime; do not bundle the development probe or require an end-user MCP client installation.
Do not label the endpoint available in Cowork until the target host actually exposes or accepts the connection.
No output plugin installation, native invocation, or scheduled execution is established by this metadata capture.
The service's identity and terms are not approved publisher metadata or legal URLs for the Creator or generated output plugin.
Keep the original snapshot intact if selecting a smaller emitted tool subset; identify any projection explicitly.
